meta.credit: Simplified by Environment Dashboard from The World Bank: World Bank Official Boundaries (GAD V1, 2025-05-07): World Bank. Changes: boundaries simplified for a small screen (shared borders kept shared), islands and lakes too small to draw left out, and CCKP's region codes matched to the World Bank's shapes. Region codes and names: The World Bank: Climate Change Knowledge Portal: Observed Climate Data, ERA5 0.25-Degree (doi:10.57966/128g-6s70): Copernicus Climate Change Service ERA5. The World Bank: Climate Change Knowledge Portal: Projected Climate Data, CMIP6 0.25-Degree (doi:10.57966/b54h-7s87): CMIP6 multi-model ensemble (World Climate Research Programme).
